title: Build lines from a needs-action row, with the same work order choice
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Open the asset record (from a customer) and its Inspections tab.
  3. A row showing "Needs action". Seed: run and complete an inspection with a Not OK finding on the asset so its row reads Needs action.
  4. Have one Needs-action row whose work order is eligible (Estimate/Approved/In Progress/Review) and one whose work order is ineligible (e.g. Complete).
custom_steps:
1. On a 'Needs action' row, confirm a build action is offered.
2. Press it and check the target choice appears up front as a menu (not a pop-up dialog), offering the same two targets in the same words as every other build entry point: this work order (by number and status) and a new work order.
3. Check the run-on work order is offered only while its status is eligible; when it is not, the target stays listed and says why.
4. Complete the build (pick a target, let the lines draft, press Add Lines) and check that Complete is treated as not eligible and that the build behaves like the build from the completed inspection screen.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A row that needs action offers a build action.
  • The action presents the target choice up front as a menu rather than opening a dialog.
  • The menu is the shared destination menu, offering the same two targets worded the same way as every other entry point.
  • The run-on work order is offered as a target only while it is an eligible build target (judged by its status on the row); when it is not, the target keeps its place and says why.
  • The action runs the same build as S2.
  • Eligibility here is identical to S2, including that Complete is not eligible.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9104 (S6 — Build from the asset Inspections tab); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S6; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R1: “A row that needs action will offer a build action”
  • S6-R2: “The action will present the target choice up front as a menu rather than opening a dialog, because the user has already decided by the time they click”
  • S6-R3: “The menu is the shared destination menu of S2-R14, so the row offers the same two targets, worded the same way as every other entry point”
  • S6-R4: “The inspection's own work order is offered as a target only while it is an eligible build target, judged by its status on the row. When it is not, the target keeps its place and says why (S2-R15)”
  • S6-R5: “The action will run the build described in S2”
  • S6-R8: “Eligibility here will be identical to S2-R5, including that Complete is not eligible”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
